content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Casey Moss?
No, this is Casey's spouse; Casey can't come to the phone right now. Is there something I can help with?
I can only discuss this with Mx Moss alone. When can Mx Moss be reached?
Okay, I understand. Casey will be available tomorrow at ten in the morning, so you can call back then.
Thank you, we will call you back then. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
